title: Extreme points of sets of probability measures and $\varphi$-divergences
summary: In this work, we prove several equivalent characterizations of the extreme points of convex sets of probability measures of the form $\mathcal{M}=\mathcal{P} \cap H$, where $\mathcal{P}$ denotes the set of all probability measures on an arbitrary measurable space $(Ω,\mathcal{F})$ and $H$ is an affine set of signed measures on $(Ω,\mathcal{F})$ with finite variation. We first give a precise measure-theoretic formulation of the heuristic that extreme measures have minimal support.
